title: Patient Payment Plans Installment Agreement Terms: Plan-Age Months on Term Extensions
content:
Under a Patient Payment Plans installment agreement, an extension of the term granted with an add-on carries plan-age months according to how long ago the agreement was signed.

**Term.** The plan-age months of the extension are 2 when the agreement was signed at least 12 whole months before the handling date, 1 when it was signed at least 6 but fewer than 12 whole months before, and 0 otherwise. These months are added to the extension months together with the rounded add-on share, and the total is then held within the room left (the tier's maximum term-extension months less the extension months already used) and is never below 0.

**Record read.** The signing date of the agreement.

| Agreement signed, before the handling date | Plan-age months |
|---|---|
| 12 whole months or more | 2 |
| 6 to 11 whole months | 1 |
| Fewer than 6 whole months | 0 |

**Boundaries (hypothetical dates).**

| Signed | Handling date | Whole months | Plan-age months |
|---|---|---|---|
| 10 June 2025 | 10 June 2026 | 12 | 2 |
| 10 June 2025 | 9 June 2026 | 11 | 1 |
| 10 December 2025 | 10 June 2026 | 6 | 1 |
| 10 December 2025 | 9 June 2026 | 5 | 0 |
